verses.1: After that, I saw another angel descending from heaven, with great authority. The earth was filled with his glory.
verses.2: And he cried out in a loud voice, saying: “Babylon has fallen! It has become a prison for demons, a place of confinement for all kinds of evil spirits and monsters. It’s also a place where all kinds of evil creatures are kept captive.”
verses.3: For from the wine of her lustfulness, all the nations were corrupted. The kings of the earth followed her lead, and the merchants of the earth became rich as a result of her plagues.
verses.4: And I heard another voice from heaven saying, “Go away from her, my people! Do not associate with her in her sins, and do not suffer any of the injuries she causes.”
verses.5: For her sins had reached even up to the heavens, and God remembered her wrongs.
verses.6: Give her what she deserves, just as she has given to others. Double the amount of food given according to her workload. In the cup, pour double the amount of wine for her.
verses.7: Whatever she was praised for and honored with, so much suffering and sorrow she endured in return. For in her heart, she said, “I am a queen who sits upon a throne.” I am not poor, nor do I see any sorrow.
verses.8: Therefore, one day she will suffer injuries, death, sorrow, and suffering. She will also be burned in fire. This is because the powerful Lord of judgment has chosen to punish her.
verses.9: And the kings of the earth will also be destroyed and cut down upon her. They who have committed acts of prostitution and oppression along with her. When they see the smoke of her burning.
verses.10: From afar, they said, out of fear of her suffering. “Oh no,” said the great city, Babylon, the powerful city. For in just one hour, your judgment will come.
verses.11: And the merchants of the land also cry and mourn over it, because no one buys their goods anymore.
verses.12: With gold and silver, as well as precious stones, pearls, rubies, zirconia, and other precious materials. Also, all kinds of wood used for making furniture, as well as all kinds of objects made from high-quality wood, copper, iron, and marble.
verses.13: And plagues, and diseases, and anger, and hatred, and jealousy, and greed, and wine, and oil, and sorghum, and wheat, and killing, and cattle, and horses, and sheep, and bodies of people.
verses.14: And your desire for pleasure was taken away from you. All the fat and shine were also taken away from you. Now, they no longer find anything like that.
verses.15: Those merchants who have become rich from her, will stand far away, crying and mourning out of fear of her torture.
verses.16: Saying: “Oh, what a magnificent city! It’s surrounded by purple and red colors. It’s adorned with gold and precious stones. It’s truly a marvelous place.”
verses.17: Because in just one hour, such a large amount of wealth was lost. Every ruler and every person who operates ships, as well as those who work on the sea, all stood far away from this scene.
verses.18: And they cried out, seeing the smoke from her fire. They said, “Who is like this great city?”
verses.19: And they put ropes around their heads. They cried out in sorrow and lamentation, saying, “Oh no! The great city has been destroyed completely. All those who owned ships in the sea, because of its greatness, have now been destroyed.”
verses.20: May Eufraínus praise Him, O heavens! And may the holy ones, the apostles, and the prophets also praise Him, for God has determined that this punishment be inflicted upon you through Him.
verses.21: And a strong messenger brought a huge stone, as big as a millstone, and threw it into the sea, saying, “In this way, the great city of Babylon will be destroyed.” And no one could still find it.
verses.22: And the sounds of trumpets, music, drums, and other instruments still cannot be heard in you. Nor can any artist of any kind be found in you yet. Even the sound of a lute still cannot be heard in you.
verses.23: And the light of the lamp still does not shine in you; nor can you hear the voice of the maiden or the maiden herself. For your merchants were the greatest ones in the land. All nations have been lost in your marketplace.
verses.24: And in it, the blood of the prophets and saints was found, as well as all those who were eaten by animals on the earth.
